splash.tagline: Houses and Rooms Renting Management Tool

login.title: Log in
login.welcome: Welcome! Please sign in to continue.
login.lockedMessage: You've entered the wrong password too many times. Please try again in {minutes} minute(s).
login.noAccount: Don't have an account?  Sign up

signup.otpSentMessage: We sent a 6-digit code to {phone}. The code expires in {countdown}.
signup.otpSendFailed: Could not send the verification code. Please try again later.
signup.otpExpired: This code has expired — tap "Resend code" to get a new one.
signup.passwordTooShort: Password must be at least 6 characters.
signup.accountCreationFailed: Could not create the account. Please try again.
signup.successBody: Your account is ready. From here you can keep track of your properties, tenants, and bills — all in one place. Take a look around.

home.emptyState: You don't have any house yet. Tap + to add your first house.

houseForm.name: Name *
houseForm.ownerBankAccountHint: Printed on every invoice for this house.
houseForm.banner: Unit prices auto-fill a new contract (invoices always use the price on the contract version); recurring fees auto-fill a new room's own recurring fees, which can then be edited per room.
houseForm.saveError:
Could not save this house. Please try again.
{error}

roomList.deleteHouseDescription: Are you sure you want to delete this house? This action cannot be undone.
roomList.deleteBlockedSnackbar: Can't delete: this house still has rooms with contract history.
roomList.deleteFailedSnackbar: Could not delete this house. Please try again.
roomList.noRoomsYet: No rooms yet. Tap + to add the first room.

roomDetail.deleteRoomDescription: Are you sure you want to delete this room? This action cannot be undone.
roomDetail.deleteBlockedSnackbar: Can't delete: this room still has contract history.
roomDetail.deleteFailedSnackbar: Could not delete this room. Please try again.
roomDetail.tapToRecordFirst: Tap to record the first reading.

roomForm.referenceRentHint: Reference rent only suggests the monthly rent when a contract is created — it is never the billed amount.
roomForm.recurringFeesHint: Pre-filled from this house's Default recurring fees when the room is created — freely editable afterward and never re-synced automatically.
roomForm.statusHint: "Occupied" is set automatically when an active contract exists — it cannot be chosen manually.
roomForm.saveError:
Could not save this room. Please try again.
{error}

readingEntry.title: Record monthly readings
readingEntry.banner: Saving stays on this screen. Invoices are created separately in the Bills tab. Empty rooms are still read — that usage belongs to the landlord, not to the next tenant.
readingEntry.noRoomsYet: No rooms yet — add a room first.
readingEntry.partialSaveError: Some rooms could not be saved — check the highlighted fields.
readingEntry.noReadingsEntered: Enter at least 1 reading before saving.

readingDetail.title: Reading detail
readingDetail.subtitle: {room}  ·  {utility}  ·  periodic reading
readingDetail.unlocked: Unlocked — no invoice uses it yet
readingDetail.banner: A reading locks as soon as any invoice other than Draft uses it. Locked readings cannot be edited; correct them with an adjustment line on the next invoice.
